name: Syngonium Pixie
description: Syngonium podophyllum 'Pixie' is a compact, dwarf cultivar of the Arrowhead Plant native to tropical Central and South America. It belongs to the Araceae family and features short, bushy stems with small, arrow-shaped to three-lobed leaves that stay compact (typically 15-30 cm height). Leaves are green, sometimes with subtle cream or white variegation. Unlike the standard Syngonium podophyllum, 'Pixie' remains small and bushy rather than vining, making it ideal for terrariums and small enclosures. It thrives in high humidity and medium to bright indirect light. Toxic if ingested.
careTips: Keep soil lightly moist but well-draining
Toxic if ingested - keep away from pets and children
